name: agent-skills
description: Reusable skills for coding agents. Includes menu-recipe (献立とレシピ), which writes review, audit, and investigation findings, pull request bodies, and issue bodies in two layers: a menu a non-engineer can decide from, plus a recipe with file paths, line numbers, repro conditions, and the fix that a coding agent can execute from. Also includes deep-review, a multi-lane review engine that runs parallel review lanes, verifies the merged findings, and reports through menu-recipe.
